As Germany's leading collagen brand, we help people feel confident at every life stage and enhance their natural beauty. At Glow25, you'll find ambitious goals and an environment that fosters ownership and values performance—regardless of which role you take on. We look forward to getting to know you. To do that, we are looking for a hands-on Retention & CLV Operator who works alongside our existing teams, keeps the big picture in view and sets up our retention engine structurally. Ownership covers Klaviyo flows, our subscription programme and our loyalty programme, plus post-purchase, replenishment, education, win-back and sales campaigns. Copy, flows and launches come from one person, with access to a rich customer data set and the freedom to build individual AI workflows. This role joins an established business with a lot of data and strong foundations. Questioning how we do things today and improving them together with the teams is encouraged. jobs.title: Growth Acquisition Operator (all genders)
jobs.description: Welcome to Glow25! We are a dynamic, fast-growing beauty and pro-aging company based in Berlin. Our heartfelt mission: Glow moments that last – for our community and for us as a team. Work at Glow25 should inspire, excite, and be fun. That's why we're looking for smart, empathetic people who take ownership and grow with us. Join Glow25 and help us redefine beauty. We're excited to meet you! These are our current challenges and future goals: Five years ago, Glow25 started from zero. Today we are one of Europe's fastest-growing collagen brands, built to a large extent on Meta and Paid Social, and our international business keeps growing. We want to get more out of every channel and every market, and we never want to become boring while doing it. To do that, we are looking for a hands-on Growth Acquisition Operator who works alongside our existing teams. New-customer acquisition is the heart of this role: with Meta and Paid Social at the core, the role steers all channels, decides where our goals sit and where the next euro is best spent, and builds complete funnels and advertorials across several countries. We are looking for a clear track record of growing a channel largely alone, paired with fresh ideas and the joy of working with colleagues who know Glow25 well. This is an established business with a lot of data and strong foundations. Questioning how we do things today and improving it together with the teams is not just welcome, it is encouraged. This is where we need your support: Paid Social Ownership : Deep hands-on expertise in Meta and Paid Social as the engine for new-customer acquisition and brand building, with real budget responsibility. Cross-Channel Steering : The ability to steer Meta, Google, Native and new channels as one system, setting clear goals per channel and deciding where the next euro performs best. Full-Funnel Building and Localization : Hands-on skill in setting up complete funnels yourself, from hooks, offers and advertorials to landing

jobs.description: Lkw rollen bei uns schon. Jetzt sollen auch die Daten rollen. Wir sind die Spedition Diez – ein familiengeführtes Logistikunternehmen am Fuß der Schwäbischen Alb. Bei uns arbeitet schon heute eine KI mit: Claude ist unsere firmeninterne KI. Was noch fehlt, ist die Brücke zwischen der KI und unseren Systemen – vor allem zu unserem TMS von Soloplan. Genau diese Brücke sollst du bauen. Du bekommst keine fertige IT-Abteilung mit hundert Tickets, sondern eine echte Pionierrolle: Du legst das Fundament für unser Data Warehouse und machst aus verstreuten Daten echtes Wissen für Disposition, Fuhrpark und Geschäftsführung. Was du bei uns bewegst Du baust unser zentrales Data Warehouse von Grund auf auf – Datenmodell, Schnittstellen, Datenqualität. Du bindest Soloplan (TMS) und unsere weiteren Systeme an, z. B. Tankkarten- und Mautdaten, Fuhrparkdaten und Buchhaltung. Du verbindest Claude mit diesen Daten, z. B. über APIs und MCP-Schnittstellen, damit Fragen wie „Welche Touren waren letzten Monat unrentabel?“ in Sekunden beantwortet sind. Du automatisierst Routinearbeiten wie Rechnungsprüfung, Auswertungen und Reports. Du bist erste Ansprechperson für KI im Haus: Du schulst Kolleginnen und Kollegen, sammelst Ideen und machst daraus funktionierende Lösungen. Du hast Datenschutz und Datensicherheit immer im Blick. Was du mitbringst Ein Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder Ähnlichem – oder vergleichbare Erfahrung aus der Praxis. Erste praktische Erfahrung mit SQL und mindestens einer Skriptsprache, am liebsten Python. Erfahrung mit Schnittstellen (REST-APIs, ETL-Prozesse) und Datenbanken. Echte Begeisterung für KI und Large Language Models – und Lust, sie praktisch einzusetzen statt nur darüber zu reden. Generalisten-Gen: Du packst gern selbst an, von der Datenbank bis zum Gespräch mit der Disposition. Erfahrung in Logistik oder mit Soloplan ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss – auch Berufseinsteiger sind herzlich willkommen, wir geben dir Zeit zum Reinwachse

jobs.title: Founder's Associate - Internship (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Building the future of robotics in Munich We're an early-stage robotics startup founded out of TUM MIRMI and backed by €1M+ in pre-seed funding from a leading European VC. Our mission is to scale robotic manufacturing applications in real industrial deployments. As a Founder's Associate, you'll work directly with the founder across nearly every aspect of building the company. From strategy, finance and hiring to business development and marketing, you'll gain a front-row seat to what it takes to build a venture-backed tech startup from the ground up. You will quickly learn how an early-stage robotics company scales its initiatives and builds impactful products. Benefits Take Ownership: Join an early-stage startup

jobs.description: Hallo! Wir sind Applysia, ein HR-Tech-Unternehmen aus Münster. Unsere Software für die Personalauswahl wird von führenden Unternehmen und Beratungen weltweit genutzt, um Assessment-Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten. Mit unserer Lösung vereinfachen und verbessern wir Assessment-Center nachhaltig, um Potenziale in Menschen vorurteilsfrei zu erkennen, zu fördern und zu entfalten. Qualifikation Du hast bereits mit modernen Frameworks wie Ruby on Rails, Spring Boot oder Laravel entwickelt. jobs.description: Inside Sales Manager (m/w/d) – Nachunternehmer Du hast Biss, Hunger auf Erfolg und willst Deals closen, statt nur über Leads zu reden? Dann ist das hier dein Spielfeld. Cosuno ist die größte Plattform, auf der Auftraggeber im Bau ihre Projekte ausschreiben und Handwerksbetriebe neue Aufträge finden. Der Nachunternehmer-Bereich ist unser am schnellsten wachsender Bereich, und 2027 wollen wir den Umsatz verdoppeln. Dafür suchen wir Closer, keine Verwalter. Deine Aufgaben Full Cycle: vom ersten Call über die Demo bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag Warme Leads statt Kaltakquise: Du rufst Handwerksbetriebe an, die bereits auf Cosuno registriert sind. Dein Setup Jeden Morgen schlägt dir die KI deine besten Leads vor. Nach der Demo erstellt die KI eine persönliche Potenzialanalyse für deinen Kunden. Was kein Gespräch ist, automatisieren wir laufend. Deine Zeit steckst du in Calls, Demos und Abschlüsse. Was dich schneller macht, bauen wir mit dir ein. Deine Ideen zählen. Woran wir dich messen Umsatz gegen dein Monatsziel – das ist die Zahl, die zählt. Aktivität und Qualität: Calls, Demos, Conversion Entwicklung: wie schnell du Feedback umsetzt und dich anpasst Team: was du teilst und wie du andere besser machst Das alles siehst du transparent im täglichen Team-Ranking. Dein Profil Mindestens 2 Jahre Vertrieb, idealerweise B2B und Full Cycle Du kannst belegen, dass du deine Ziele konstant übertriffst, also über 100 %. Closing-Mindset: Für dich zählt der Abschluss, nicht der Prozess. Du überzeugst am Telefon, per Mail und in der Demo. jobs.title: Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Role We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account. If the FMCS has an issue at 03:00, you're the one who knows what to do. To join our team, you should be excited to: Operate, monitor and maintain our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum) across servers, operator stations and displays Maintain and diagnose our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs and their remote I/O, and adapt control logic within the existing standardised structure Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation Verify instrument calibration and troubleshoot analog and digital field signals - multimeter in hand, not only from a screen Add new datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and tune alarms so operators trust the system Keep documentation current - as-built drawings, tag lists, change records - and uphold change control Act as the technical counterpart to contractors and vendors, and support qualification and audits with system evidence Your Qualifications One of two equivalent qualification paths: a completed apprenticeship as an Electronics Technician for Automation Technology plus further training as a state-certif

jobs.title: Chief Medical Officer, UK/I & EMEA
jobs.description: Chief Medical Officer, UK/I & EMEA The Role Lyrebird is reshaping how clinical documentation happens across the NHS and in Ireland, and we’re looking for a Chief Medical Officer to be the senior clinical voice of the business. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll make sure everything we build, deploy and sell is clinically safe, evidence-based and genuinely useful to clinicians and patients. You’ll own our clinical safety and governance framework, including DCB0129 and oversight of the Clinical Safety Officer function. You’ll shape the product roadmap alongside Product and Engineering, build the evidence base that NHS and HSE buyers need, and act as a trusted peer to CCIOs, CMIOs, medical directors and ICB leaders. This role suits a practising or recently practising doctor who has led at a senior level in the NHS and knows digital health from the inside. You’re comfortable moving between a board presentation, a hazard log and a conversation with engineers in the same afternoon. You’ll enjoy the pace of a high-growth company, but you’ll never trade safety for speed. You believe clinical AI should be held to the same standards as the rest of medicine, and you want to be the person who proves it can be. About Us Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. In the UK, that includes NHS trusts across Cheshire and Merseyside, Alder Hey Children’s, and the South West London Acute Provider Collaborative, one of the largest ambient AI deployments in the country. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale. jobs.description: Notre univers eCential Robotics est une entreprise française innovante spécialisée dans la chirurgie assistée par robot. Nous développons et commercialisons des solutions alliant imagerie 2D/3D robotisée, navigation en temps réel et robotique chirurgicale, afin d’accompagner les chirurgiens orthopédiques et neurochirurgiens dans leurs interventions. Reconnue à l’international, eCential Robotics poursuit son ambition de devenir un leader du secteur de la robotique chirurgicale, un domaine en pleine croissance, et de contribuer chaque jour à façonner le bloc opératoire de demain. jobs.title: Control & Estimation Intern
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on. These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation. Your mission The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions. Responsibilities Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution

Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month. Reports to: CTO About the venture: ROB E ROB E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field. Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory. The role You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer. Responsibilities Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes. Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification. Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. C

jobs.title: macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a hands-on macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer to engineer, automate and continuously improve the services that support our global Apple device estate. This role is focused on delivering a secure, reliable and consistent macOS experience at scale through Jamf Pro, reusable code, APIs and modern engineering practices. You will replace repetitive administration and one-off scripts with maintainable automation for device enrolment, configuration, application delivery, patching, compliance and lifecycle management. Working across Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager, identity, security, asset and service-management platforms, you will build integrations and workflows that make Apple device services easier to operate, measure and support. Engineering mindset Automation is the product, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who sees a manual Jamf task, fragile policy or recurring Mac support issue and asks, “How can we make this reliable, reusable and self-service?” You should be comfortable working from Apple and Jamf documentation, investigating unfamiliar behaviours and translating operational requirements into production-quality automation. Your solutions account for failure, test changes before release, scale to an enterprise environment, provide useful telemetry and favour reusable frameworks over isolated scripts. You take ownership from design through operation, document your work and balance long-term platform improvements with immediate business needs. What success looks like You will measurably reduce manual effort, deployment lead time and configuration drift across the macOS estate. Enrollment, configuration, software delivery, patching, security compliance and device lifecycle processes will become increasingly automated, observable, auditable and recoverable. jobs.title: Stage Consumentengedrag
jobs.description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱 Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. jobs.description: Technical Sales Engineer This is a future role. We're building a shortlist now and will contact you when it opens. About us Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit. We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked. Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space. We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, and Innovate UK. Position Overview London · Full time · On-site You'll be the technical voice in our sales conversations. You'll help satellite operators understand what laser ranging data and our retroreflectors can do for their missions. What you'll do Run technical discovery calls and demos with prospective customers Scope solutions: which tracking tier, which data products and which retroreflector Answer technical requirements in RFPs and supplier questionnaires Support customers as they integrate retroreflectors onto their spacecraft Feed customer needs back to product and engineering Build technical sales material: case studies, data samples and integration guides What you'll bring An engineering or physics background, ideally in space Experience in technical sales, pre-sales, applications engineering or systems engineering The ability to explain complex ideas simply, to engineers and executives alike Comfort travelling to customers and conferences Nice to have Satellite operations, GNSS, space situational awareness

Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source. Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent. Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.   Activités et responsabilités Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents. Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.   Vos responsabilités : Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple. Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage. Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL. Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès. Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions. Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions,

jobs.title: CDI - Senior AI Strategist - Paris
jobs.description: Prenez en main un stream de transformation IA, au contact direct des clients, de la vision aux résultats mesurables. L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes.  Et tout commence par vous.   Mission En tant que Senior AI Strategist , vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients : vous cadrez, analysez, prototypez et recommandez, vous coachez les consultants juniors, et vous voyez vos recommandations prendre vie avec nos équipes Engineering. Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous cadrez les processus cibles et la roadmap de votre stream, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour. Activités & Responsabilités Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA Vous contribuez à cadrer la vision IA et à la roadmap du stream, qualifiez et priorisez les cas d’usage, et arbitrez entre solutions IA et non-IA. Vous investiguez les processus métier, identifiez les irritants et les causes racines, et proposez des pistes de refonte priorisées, en pensant d’abord lean et en n’utilisant l’IA que là où elle

Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle. jobs.description: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.  The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.  About the OS Integration team: The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment.
